units.source_text: 古歌：“女郎花艳艳，秋野竞芬芳。

en.t: An old poem says: The maiden flowers bloom brilliantly, vying in fragrance across the autumn fields.

units.source_text: 喋喋叨叨者，时光亦不长。”

en.t: For those who chatter on and on, even time itself is not long enough.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 因诗中咏女郎花，故引此古歌中句来责他。

en.t: Because the poem mentions maiden flowers, she quoted a line from this old poem to reproach him.
